M4: Financing Just Energy Transition
Chapter 2 Overview
This chapter focuses on the critical role of public sector investments in promoting sustainable energy investments, particularly in regions with limited access to private capital.
It highlights how public funds can act as a catalyst to attract private sector investments and addresses the limitations of relying solely on government resources.
The chapter explores regulatory frameworks, fiscal measures and incentives, concessional finance and policy reforms as essential tools that can incentivize and enable sustainable energy investments.

This chapter examines the vital role of public sector investment in driving the global energy transition, especially in regions with limited access to private capital - a key barrier for energy transition.
It highlights how public funds can catalyze private investment and not just rely solely on government resources.

This chapter will focus on key areas including:
Regulatory frameworks
Fiscal incentives
Concessional finance
Policy reforms
These are all enablers that can scale sustainable energy investments.
